rows.line: Rumor carried a name: Relief-Freighter Choir-Tender. The dark kept the rest.

pages.alt: The broken bow and stern of the Concord Vigilant separated around a wide black cavity.
pages.caption: Long-range reconstruction from the recovered navigation record.
pages.title: The Missing Convoy
pages.fragment: Concord Vigilant held the lane nine hours. Civilians jumped behind her.
pages.body: The navigation record terminates inside Ceres without a gate-exit acknowledgment. Its final vectors converge on the split capital hull now catalogued as the Wreck Cathedral.

pages.alt: Registry silhouette of a capital hull split immediately aft of its bridge.
pages.caption: Registry geometry match: Concord Vigilant.
pages.title: Capital Hull Located
pages.fragment: The hull broke aft of the bridge. The Marker survived.
pages.body: Registry geometry identifies the wreck as the Concord Vigilant despite the missing transponder core. The surviving frame spacing and bridge profile exclude every other hull in the convoy manifest.

pages.alt: Close view of exposed frames, cold blue emergency lights, and the surviving amber Marker.
pages.caption: Emergency relay timing recovered beside the surviving Marker.
pages.title: The Clock Stopped First
pages.fragment: Concord claims the bow. Frontier claims the stern.
pages.body: The emergency relay clock lost synchronization before the structural breakup recorded by the hull sensors. Whatever stopped the convoy interrupted its coordination channel before it tore the Vigilant apart.

pages.alt: View through the capital wreck cavity past torn frames, engine bells, and exposed service structure.
pages.caption: The clamp fracture faces outward from the traversable cavity.
pages.title: Released From Inside
pages.fragment: Neither tows it. Scavengers nest inside the engine bells.
pages.body: Clamp scoring and displaced fasteners face outward from the fly-through cavity. The carried device was released from inside the Vigilant rather than torn away by an external collision.

pages.alt: Forensic wireframe through the wreck cavity showing the black-box cradle and surrounding structure.
pages.caption: Receiver reconstruction after physical black-box delivery.
pages.title: What Was Carried
pages.fragment: Vigilant’s nine-hour hold is a Concord training case. The civilians are a footnote in the same case file.
pages.body: The recovered black box binds the convoy route, relay clock, and internal release to one custody record. Its final entry identifies a classified archive package, but not the party that ordered the transfer.
